name: Judd's Hill Wine Sales Excellence Rubric
description: This rubric evaluates wine sales professionals at Judd's Hill on their ability to engage sophisticated wine enthusiasts, personalize the tasting experience, effectively present the wine club, close sales, upsell products, and capture customer data through verbal communication and sales techniques.

criteria.name: Wine Club Presentation
criteria.description: Effectively communicates the unique benefits and value of Judd's Hill wine club membership, tailoring the presentation to the guests' preferences for European-style wines with lower alcohol content, and their existing membership experience with Silver Oak.

scoringLevels.description: Needs Improvement: Demonstrates minimal competency with significant gaps in approach; misses key opportunities to engage customers effectively; uses generic or inappropriate language; fails to address customer needs or preferences.

Developing: Shows basic competency but lacks refinement; inconsistently applies sales techniques; demonstrates partial understanding of customer needs; misses some opportunities for personalization or sales advancement.

Proficient: Demonstrates solid competency with generally effective approach; addresses most customer needs appropriately; applies sales techniques with reasonable success; shows good understanding of products and customer preferences.

Strong: Exhibits advanced competency with highly effective approach; consistently addresses customer needs with personalized solutions; applies sophisticated sales techniques; demonstrates excellent product knowledge and customer insight.

Exceptional: Displays mastery with an outstanding approach that exceeds expectations; anticipates and addresses all customer needs with highly personalized solutions; applies expert sales techniques with natural fluency; demonstrates perfect timing and exceptional customer understanding.

performanceLevels.name: Needs Improvement
performanceLevels.description: Shows significant gaps in wine sales fundamentals. Fails to personalize the experience to Jamie and Robert's sophisticated preferences. Wine club presentation is weak or missing, rarely asks for the sale, and makes no effective upselling attempts. Data capture is minimal or absent, and engagement lacks warmth and personalization.

performanceLevels.name: Developing
performanceLevels.description: Demonstrates basic wine sales skills with inconsistent execution. Creates a somewhat generic experience that partially addresses Jamie and Robert's preferences. Wine club presentation lacks compelling benefits, sales requests seem uncomfortable, and upselling attempts are minimal. Data capture is incomplete and engagement shows limited personalization.

performanceLevels.name: Proficient
performanceLevels.description: Shows solid wine sales competency with generally effective approaches. Creates a reasonably personalized experience that addresses most of Jamie and Robert's preferences. Presents the wine club adequately, asks for the sale, and attempts upselling with moderate success. Captures basic customer data and maintains positive engagement throughout the interaction.

performanceLevels.name: Strong
performanceLevels.description: Demonstrates advanced wine sales capabilities with highly effective techniques. Creates a personalized experience for Jamie and Robert that acknowledges their sophisticated palate and new Yountville residence. Presents the wine club persuasively, asks for the sale confidently, and successfully upsells with good timing. Captures customer data effectively while maintaining authentic engagement.

performanceLevels.name: Exceptional
performanceLevels.description: Represents the gold standard in wine sales excellence. Consistently delivers a highly personalized experience that perfectly addresses Jamie and Robert's sophisticated preferences. Masterfully presents the wine club with compelling benefits, confidently asks for the sale, and skillfully upsells with natural elegance. Captures all necessary customer data while building genuine rapport that reflects Judd's Hill's boutique character.
